info.title: Garden API
info.description:
API specification for Garden v3.

`POST /quote` prices a swap and creates the order in a single call, returning the transaction to initiate it on-chain.

Orders, assets, chains, schemas, liquidity and policy are served under `/v3`.

A swap can start from an EVM chain, Solana, Starknet or Bitcoin. Any chain can be the destination.

garden-app-id.name: garden-app-id
garden-app-id.description: If you do not yet have an app ID, please follow these [steps](/api-reference/setup).

is_active.description: `false` for a legacy chain that is no longer supported. The default listing returns only active chains.

total_earnings.description: Total earnings in asset units for the affiliate.

total_earnings_usd.description: Total earnings in USD for the mentioned asset for the affiliate.

affiliate.description: The address that will receive the earnings.

token_address.description: Contract address for the affiliate fee asset.

claim_amount.description: Amount available for claiming in asset units. Only included if the affiliate has not yet claimed their earnings.

claim_amount_usd.description: Amount available for claiming in USD. Only included if the affiliate has not yet claimed their earnings.

claim_signature.description: Signature for claiming earnings. Only included if the affiliate has not yet claimed their earnings.

claim_contract.description: Contract address for claiming earnings. Only included if the affiliate has not yet claimed their earnings.

TokenSchema.description: Always **null** for native assets with no address. **Example:** ETH on Ethereum.

is_active.description: `false` for a legacy asset that is no longer supported. The default listing returns only active assets.

swap_id.description: A unique identifier for the swap.

delegate.description: Address that performed the swap for the user, if applicable.

timelock.description: Timelock for the swap (in block numbers).

asset_price.description: Price of the asset during swap.

secret.description:
The secret used to lock the funds on-chain.
**Default:** "" *(empty string)*

instant_refund_tx.description: **(Optional)** Instant refund transaction bytes. Only available for source swaps on UTXO-based chains. **Example:** Bitcoin.

initiate_tx_hash.description:
On-chain transaction hash of initiate.
**Default:** "" *(empty string)*

redeem_tx_hash.description:
On-chain transaction hash of redeem.
**Default:** "" *(empty string)*

refund_tx_hash.description:
On-chain transaction hash of refund.
**Default:** "" *(empty string)*

initiate_block_number.description:
Block number of the initiate transaction.
**Default:** "0"

redeem_block_number.description:
Block number of the redeem transaction.
**Default:** "0"

refund_block_number.description:
Block number of the refund transaction.
**Default:** "0"

current_confirmations.description:
Number of confirmations received so far.
**Default:** 0

order_id.description: A unique identifier for the order.

deadline.description: Unix timestamp after which the order expires.

affiliate_fees.description: Integrator fees associated with the order.

default.description: Default policy for routes not covered by specific rules.

isolation_groups.description: Assets in an isolation group can ONLY trade with other assets in the same group.

blacklist_pairs.description: Explicitly forbidden trading pairs using pattern matching.

whitelist_overrides.description: Explicit overrides that bypass other restrictions.

owner.description: Address of the user. **(Optional)** on one leg, where it is resolved from the other.

delegate.description: **(Optional)** Executes the swap on behalf of the user. Use this when calling Garden from your own smart contract; provide your contract’s address here.

amount.description: Raw asset amount in the smallest unit. Present on exactly one leg: on `source` to spend an exact amount, on `destination` to receive one.

asset.description: Asset the fee is taken in.

amount.description: Raw asset amount in the smallest unit (e.g., satoshis for BTC, wei for ETH).

display.description: Amount after applying decimal places (e.g., 0.01 BTC).

value.description: Fiat value (in USD) equivalent of the displayed amount.

V3QuoteView.description: A priced quote. A request may return one per solver.

id.description: A unique identifier for the quote, also used as the order ID.

secret_hash.description: SHA256 of the secret. One per quote.

fee.description: In BIPS (base index points), where 100 bips = 1%.

deadline.description: Unix timestamp after which the quote expires.

request_id.description: A unique identifier for the request.

V3QuoteState.description: The status of the quote. `open` - not yet funded. `consumed` - the source initiate was detected. `expired` - the deadline passed first.

tx_hash.description: Hash of the transaction that funded the source leg.

fee.description: In BIPS (base index points), where 100 bips = 1%.

V3EvmTransaction.description: An EVM transaction to sign and broadcast. Numeric fields are hex strings.

V3StarknetCall.description: A Starknet contract call. Submit the approval and initiate calls together as one multicall.

approval_transaction.description: Can be `null`, if the source asset is native or the user has already given approval.

core_to_evm_transfer.description: Present only for a HyperCore source: bridge to HyperEVM with this transaction first, then send the initiate.

approval_transaction.description: Can be `null`, if user has already given approval.

versioned_tx.description: A base64-encoded `VersionedTransaction`. Refresh the blockhash before signing.

to.description: The address of the recipient. Send `amount` to it.

V3Initiate.description: Everything needed to fund the source leg. The body is chain-specific, following the source chain's family.

signatures.description: A Schnorr signature generated by the initiator over the instant refund hash obtained from the [instant refund hash endpoint](./instant-refund-hash). This signature represents the initiator’s partial spend authorization for the Taproot script controlling the initiator's UTXO. Submitting this signature allows the solver to later provide its own Schnorr signature to fully satisfy the Taproot instant refund leaf and broadcast the refund transaction instantly, without requiring further initiator interaction.

post.description:
Price a swap and create the order in a single call.

Set `amount` on the leg you want to fix: on `source` to spend an exact amount, or on `destination` to receive one. The other side is returned in the response, along with the `initiate` transaction.

400.description: Malformed request, or the route cannot be priced.

get.description: The quote's state and the terms it was priced at. See `GET /orders/{order}` for settlement.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Quote id from `POST /quote`.

post.description: Submit the transaction hash of your initiate so the swap is picked up immediately. Optional, as swaps are detected automatically.

400.description: Malformed request, or the transaction does not fund this quote.

get.description: Get a price for a route without creating an order.

parameters.name: from_amount
parameters.description: Source amount in base units. Pass this or `to_amount`.

parameters.name: to_amount
parameters.description: Destination amount in base units. Pass this or `from_amount`.

400.description: No order pair found for this route.

post.summary: Get instant refund hash for the given swap.
post.description:
The hashes to sign for a Bitcoin instant refund, one per UTXO backing the source leg. Bitcoin only.

Submit the signatures with `PATCH /orders/{order}?action=instant-refund`.

200.description: One hash per UTXO, in input order.

400.description: Unknown order, or its source leg is not a Bitcoin swap.
